verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says private connections are live automatically from the moment you deploy, which suggests internal networking with no VPC setup. That is a single thin claim. Nothing in the pack explains how service-to-service traffic is kept off the public internet, and there is no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: documentation of how private networking works (internal DNS/addressing, isolation guarantees), confirmation that internal traffic never traverses the public internet, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity

citations.quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
